description: Normal-support raft-base direction endpoints and the zero-width configured fallback, with physical path and emitted-GCode witnesses.

mutants.description: Force raft-base deposition direction to zero; both the 359 degree wrap witness and 90 degree contrast must remain visible.
Treat the registered zero support width as explicit instead of inheriting line_width; the auto row must still resolve to the configured 0.5 mm rather than the 0.4 mm nozzle.
